name: hcportal_getNewsflashReaders
description: Returns every user who has interacted with a specific newsflash (dismissed or snoozed), ordered by UpdatedAt DESC; users who never responded are not included. Works on soft-deleted newsflashes. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; no admin/permission gate in the SP (any signed-in portal user may call it).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString.

parameters.name: newsflashId
parameters.description: Required: the newsflash to query. Validated for NULL before auth. Must exist (including soft-deleted).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on NULL @newsflashId (checked BEFORE auth), auth failure, 'Newsflash not found', or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: ReaderList
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows, one per user who has interacted with this newsflash, ordered by UpdatedAt DESC.

columns.name: isDismissed
columns.description: 1 = user permanently dismissed; 0 = user snoozed (Read Later)

columns.name: nextShowDate
columns.description: Date from which the newsflash will be shown again after a snooze. NULL when isDismissed=1.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: UTC timestamp of the last interaction

codeSmells.issue: No admin gate in the SP
codeSmells.detail: Lines 41-49: only ValidatePortalAuth runs, so any signed-in portal user can list which hashers (publicHasherId, names) read a given newsflash.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 72-75: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row.

Lines 29-33: a NULL @newsflashId is reported before ValidatePortalAuth runs, so an unauthenticated caller gets a validation message rather than an auth failure. Harmless but inconsistent with the auth-first pattern.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
